expectedChanges: Protect page backing using the existing gradient edge color; retain normal gradient pixels and constant theme preference.
Fit area title lines and subtitles within their actual parent without changing authored words or line breaks.

ownerDecisions: The author requests deployment of these reversible investigation findings to Staging.

rulesApplied: Lock before implementation; base-owned gates and exact SHA CI; independent browser verification.
plan.rollback: Revert this single Staging PR including its CSS, message handling and corresponding HTML resource versions.
outOfScope: Production, X or Safari native chrome, forced toolbar colors, developer UI, art/lighting, changes to the desktop/phone breakpoint or game input outside the message window.
unverified: Physical iPhone/X native chrome and effect on original seam; native toolbar color remains host-controlled.
plan.problem: A white seam of six CSS pixels appears at the X browser toolbar boundary. Narrow game frames clip long arrival headings and short landscape dialogs. A drag on an overflowing message triggers immediate dismissal.
plan.currentContract: Town screen uses 9:16 on small coarse pointers and 1:2 otherwise. The page has opaque gradient stops with a transparent backing. The area heading and message dialog are inside the game frame; the latter already has overflow-y auto.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Viewport-relative child title sizing ignores the narrower rendered frame. Short landscape dialogs retain portrait control reservation even when modal; touch guarding and pointerdown prevent reading overflowing text.
plan.design: Keep gradient imagery and give its root/body/container an opaque fallback; make child headings fit the available parent; size short-landscape messages to the game frame, allow native vertical panning within the message only and advance on a completed tap. Reuse the existing interaction action and exact asset URLs with a new revision.
alternativesRejected: Resize/stretch the game canvas or change the art
Override X-owned controls or force a global dark scheme
Change directional controls or implement custom scrolling.
plan.migration: Cache revisions only; no storage or content migration.
plan.compatibility: Desktop and normal portrait, keyboard dismissal, backdrop dismissal, movement after dismissal, authored multiline titles, frame proportions and theme-color remain compatible.
boundaryCases: 390x661 at DPR3 versus 320x454 portrait, 568x320 and 844x310 landscape; 768/769 breakpoint and toolbar-height changes
A short counter message versus long scrollable content, tap vs pan, reopen after scrolling, keyboard, touch outside a message.

Run related existing regressions, trusted Scope, Risk, Impact and Static on exact HEAD and verify required CI and Staging Pages bytes after merge.
